test_title: PYST 2: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 27 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: There are five friends, Ankita, Parul, Ashna, Bhanu, Ritika. Ashna is the tallest. Ankita is shorter than Parul but taller than Ritika. Bhanu is shorter than Parul but taller than Ankita. Who is taller than Ritika but shorter than Bhanu?
solution:
Given

1) Ashna is the tallest.

2) Ankita is shorter than Parul but taller than Ritika.

Parul > Ankita > Ritika

3) Bhanu is shorter than Parul but taller than Ankita.

Parul > Bhanu > Ankita

Combing all (1), (2) and (3) we get

Ashna > Parul > Bhanu > Ankita > Ritika

Hence, the correct answer is "Ankita".
